text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - autopage fired for gpu-host-4956 in us-west-2c. Symptoms: kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady. Pager: @eng-oncall :bangbang:

pagerduty: Incident #PD-89123 auto-triggered (service: gpu-node-health). Initial alert: node gpu-host-4956 stopped responding to kubelet probes.

amy: acked on call, fetching console logs and system metrics. on my way in. :running_shirt_with_sash:

raj: joining — pulling serial console now. can someone check which tenants are on that host?

diane: I see increased pod restarts for tenant-evex and model-serving-svc on the cluster dashboard. linking trace: https://dash.internal/redwood/clusters/us-west-2c/nodes/gpu-host-4956

ops-bot: Autopage details:
- node: gpu-host-4956
- reason: kernel_panic (OOPS)
- kubelet: NotReady (last heartbeat 30s)
- last heartbeat: 2026-03-15T02:23:18Z

amy: copy. raj, can you paste the last serial console dump?

raj: pasting tail of serial console here:
```
[ 1234.567890] ------------[ cut here ]------------
[ 1234.568000] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 1234.568100] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted 6.1.0-rt5
[ 1234.568200] Call Trace:
  < 0xffffffff8102a1c7 > show_stack+0x35/0x54
  < 0xffffffff8103b7a2 > panic+0x1f2/0x2a0
[ 1234.568300] ---[ end trace 1a2b3c4d5e6f ]---
```

diane: ugh. looks like a hard kernel OOPS. could be driver or hw. infra-eng -- can you check BMC/IPMI and whether we can power-cycle remotely?

infra-eng: on it. querying IPMI for host 4956. getting chassis status...

infra-eng: IPMI shows power state: ON but no serial activity since panic. trying soft AC power cycle via BMC now.

sre-lead: procedural note — if soft cycle doesn't return kubelet within 5m we should cordon + drain then evict workloads and failover to reserved capacity. communicate potential tenant impact. amy, you own the cordon/drain?

amy: yes taking cordon/drain now to reduce further scheduling churn. running:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-host-4956 --context=prod-us-west-2c
kubectl drain gpu-host-4956 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30 --timeout=10m
```

raj: BMC soft cycle command returned OK, host is rebooting (IPMI response: power cycle requested). serial console shows early kernel messages: POST -> device enumeration -> then freezes before kernel init.

customer-success: ping — we are seeing 2 customer support tickets referencing increased LLM latency and transient 503s for tenant-evex. we need an ETA to tell customers.

sre-lead: current plan: 1) attempt soft power cycle (in progress). 2) if host fails to join within 10m, infra-eng to escalate to hardware RMA and ops to migrate affected tenants to reserved-capacity nodes. 3) keep CS updated every 15m.

amy: drain completed, most pods rescheduled. a few stateful pods required manual restart; I restarted them and monitored. cluster shows capacity pressure but reserve pool covered immediate requests.

raj: serial console now shows repeated PCIe enumeration errors, also Xid 79 on GPU side in dmesg before panic. suspect GPU hardware fault (Xid 79 = GPU page fault/firmware error).

infra-eng: confirming—NVLINK logs show ECC count spikes, GPU3 reporting fatal error. opening an RMA ticket with vendor: RMA-RED-1129. filing ticket and attaching logs.

diane: noting customer impact in incident notes: tenants with colocated models experienced increased p99 latency and a handful of 503s during reschedule window ~02:22-02:40 UTC. No data plane compromise. CS: please push update to affected customers: heads-up + mitigation steps.

customer-success: drafting message now. sending to legal for review (no PII exposure). ETA 10m.

ops-bot: Reminder: apply node taint while hardware issue is open: kubectl taint nodes gpu-host-4956 hardware=needs-rma:NoSchedule

amy: taint applied and added note on node object. tagging incident on PagerDuty as acked -> escalated to hardware.

pagerduty: Incident PD-89123 status: acknowledged by amy. escalation routed to infra-eng for RMA.

raj: leaving serial console attached in case infra-eng needs more traces. dropping `sosreport` and kernel logs to /srv/incident/gpu-host-4956/ for later forensic.

infra-eng: RMA ticket created and vendor confirmed parts shipment ETA 3 business days. scheduling temporary capacity shift until replacement arrives.

sre-lead: post-incident tasks: 1) run full fleet scan for similar Xid 79 patterns across GPU fleet. 2) consider quiet-drain policy for nodes showing early Xid warnings. 3) add alert for ECC spike per host.

amy: handing off to infra-eng for long-lived hardware tracking. infra-eng owns until host is returned and validated. I will stay on the incident until RMA confirms.

infra-eng: ack takeover. updating incident doc and will coordinate RMA and replacement scheduling.

customer-success: sent update to impacted customers: short notice, actions taken, expected full recovery timeline (replacement in ~3 business days). customers acknowledged, one asked for deeper RCA once available.

sre-lead: thanks team. will create postmortem once hardware RMA and logs reviewed. assigning owners for follow-ups. closing on-call thread but leaving incident open in PagerDuty until RMA resolved. :white_check_mark:
